prompt.sw: Kwa nini malipo madogo ya kila siku ni magumu moja kwa moja kwenye blockchain?
prompt.en: Why are small everyday payments hard to make directly on-chain?

label.sw: Bloku ni chache na ada zinaweza kuwa kubwa
label.en: Blocks are slow and fees can be high

explanation.sw: Bloku huja takriban kila dakika 10 na nafasi yake ni ndogo.
explanation.en: Blocks come about every 10 minutes and space is limited.

prompt.sw: Chaneli ya malipo inagusa blockchain lini?
prompt.en: When does a payment channel touch the blockchain?

label.en: Only when it opens and closes

explanation.sw: Malipo ya katikati ni jumbe zilizotiwa sahihi tu.
explanation.en: Payments in between are just signed messages.

prompt.sw: Nini kinazuia nodi ya kati kuiba malipo?
prompt.en: What stops an intermediate node from stealing a payment?

label.en: Bitcoin's rules, which enforce the channels

explanation.sw: Hakuna kampuni katikati; kila chaneli inalindwa na Bitcoin.
explanation.en: There's no company in the middle; Bitcoin enforces every channel.

prompt.en: What does Lightning ask of its users?

label.en: To stay online and manage liquidity

explanation.sw: Nodi lazima itazame blockchain na chaneli zinahitaji salio pande sahihi.
explanation.en: Nodes must watch the chain and channels need balance on the right side.
